assertions.name: low_order_recurrence_on_corrected_ck
assertions.source: No low-order constant-coeff recurrence (≤ d=4) on #1824's bias-corrected c_k — independent Hankel-method confirmation of #1824 probe 6.c. Expected False (kernel genuinely higher-order).

description: Task-1 cross-check (kernel deepening): applies the Step-2 (#1823) Hankel-rank + over-determined recurrence method to #1824's bias-corrected c_2..c_10. Result: no low-order C-finite recurrence (Hankel non-collapse; no constant-coeff fit ≤ d=4) — INDEPENDENTLY confirms #1824 probe 6.c (sliding-window depth-2 α/β unstable). Two methods agree ⇒ the no-low-order-kernel result is robust to de-biasing, NOT extraction noise (resolves the Step-2 caveat). The kernel R is genuinely higher-order; per the Lean grounding the keystone needs canonical c_11+ or the categorical Q_A·cos α_eff derivation. Diagnostic-only; sourced c_k pinned from #1824 probe 6.a.
